scripts.pretest:previews: node scripts/build-sandbox-cli.mjs && python3 scripts/build-sandbox-plugin.py && python3 scripts/build-nanobot-assets.py --fixture
scripts.pretest:grants: node scripts/build-sandbox-cli.mjs && python3 scripts/build-sandbox-plugin.py && python3 scripts/build-nanobot-assets.py --fixture
scripts.pretest:sandbox-browser: node scripts/build-sandbox-cli.mjs && python3 scripts/build-sandbox-plugin.py && python3 scripts/build-nanobot-assets.py --fixture
